title: Polynomial-Time Circuit Satisfiability Queries
statement: Let $d,y,e$ be polynomial-time computable functions from finite binary strings to finite binary strings. The language of strings $z$ for which the pair encoding $\\langle d(z), \\langle y(z),e(z)\\rangle\\rangle$ is a yes-instance of circuit satisfiability belongs to $\\mathsf{P}$; here a yes-instance encodes a fan-in-two Boolean circuit together with an input on which the circuit evaluates to true.
